competitor_advantages.point: Bundled with the fastest-growing restaurant POS (Toast, ~180k locations) — the closest analog to Genius's POS+DMB bundle

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Delphi is part of Toast’s enterprise drive-thru bundle, spanning displays and POS integration.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Delphi is part of Toast’s enterprise drive-thru bundle, spanning displays and POS integration.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Toast acquired Delphi in February 2023 and launched Toast Drive-Thru in April 2026 using Delphi expertise.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: At QSR accounts, map Delphi boards and order-confirmation screens to Toast POS rollout and hardware approvals.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Launch does not establish deployed site count or a separate Delphi commercial offer.
